285435591.description:
Vintage Electrical Insulator Lot - 14 Pieces
Hemingray, Brookfield, H.G. Co., Locke
Aqua, Green, Clear Glass and Brown Ceramic, Late 19th to Mid-20th Century
Comprehensive collection of 14 vintage telegraph and electrical power line insulators, featuring classic pressed glass and glazed ceramic examples from prominent American manufacturers including Hemingray, Brookfield, and Locke. These heavy industrial relics showcase the technological evolution of American infrastructure, valued for their sculptural ribbed forms, embossed lettering, and rich glass colorations.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray-42 glass insulator, aqua teal with drip points
Hemingray-42 glass insulator, clear with drip points
Hemingray-19 glass insulator, aqua teal with drip points
Hemingray-56 glass insulator, clear ribbed design
Hemingray-17 glass insulator, clear compact design
Brookfield glass insulator, deep green teal
H.G. CO. glass pony insulator, dark teal green
Locke porcelain saddle-top insulator, dark brown glaze
Brown glazed ceramic high-voltage pin insulator
5 additional Hemingray and related style glass insulators in aqua and green
Condition:
Authentic vintage field-used condition. The glass and porcelain retain glossy surfaces with varied fleabiting, small wire-wear chips, and surface abrasions typical of retired utility line hardware. Embossing remains clear and legible across marked pieces.
